menu.name: Truffle Fries
menu.description: Crispy golden hand-cut fries tossed in white truffle oil, grated parmesan cheese, and fresh rosemary. Served with garlic aioli.

menu.name: Heirloom Tomato Bruschetta
menu.description: Toasted artisan sourdough topped with marinated heirloom tomatoes, garlic, fresh basil, and a drizzle of aged balsamic glaze.

menu.name: Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon
menu.description: Crispy skin-on salmon fillet served over a bed of creamy lemon-herb risotto and roasted asparagus, topped with dill butter.

menu.name: Wild Mushroom Rigatoni
menu.description: Rigatoni pasta tossed with a rich, velvety wild mushroom cream sauce, caramelized onions, and fresh thyme.

menu.name: Smoked Gorgonzola Burger
menu.description: Prime beef patty, melted gorgonzola cheese, crispy bacon, arugula, and fig jam on a toasted brioche bun. Served with side salad.

menu.name: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
menu.description: Decadent dark chocolate cake with a gooey, molten center. Served warm with a scoop of Madagascar vanilla bean ice cream.

menu.name: Classic Matcha Latte
menu.description: Premium stone-ground Japanese matcha whisked with steamed oat milk and a touch of organic agave nectar.

menu.name: Hibiscus Rose Iced Tea
menu.description: Cold-brewed herbal hibiscus tea infused with organic rosewater, fresh mint, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
